1796921987681366046 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 💜 7 🔁 1
Depressed people, often also people with external loci of control, do better when they are in environments that give them little room for proactive agency other than follow orders. This is why Wild West environments like the Internet ruin these people. No structure.

Skill issue.

===

1796941027682492701 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
By the way, this kind of semantic imprisoning is a huge part of the rationalist project. Beware!
https://t.co/WDFGJxtSE4
  [Quoting @sunriseoath: At least, Yudkowsky allowing people to fall into his arms is less wrong (roll credits) than letting them fall off a cliff.]
↓
1796941415747879148 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
I think in some ways the sequences are a good example of Yudkowsky getting people to fail upward, though in this case he captures most of the gain from autistic people who start to care about AI alignment due to reading his writings and getting sniped.
https://t.co/u0Q0Sf1K9b
  [Quoting @sunriseoath: Yudkowsky is fine with rationalists having stilted personalities and no understanding of how system determines reality, because it helps him (who does understand all these concepts, quite obviously) achieve his goal of getting a bunch of people working on alignment.]
↓
1796941913557250146 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
The weaknesses of a movement usually shows their blind spots. Rationalists are, as a group, unable to muster up a convincing aesthetic. This prevents them from speaking to a wider audience, though it also ends up being a useful entry heuristic.
https://t.co/mNiFCLRr1z
  [Quoting @sunriseoath: The methods of rationality are excellent tools, but so is poetry.  Religion is a weird thing that combines an apparatus for reasoning about the world with a fixed canon and common tongue for speaking about social reality.  EAs are hard-pressed to truly dominate the culture.]
↓
1796942223579193377 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Maybe the people who enter the Yud matrix are better off in there. Unironically, they are probably more likely to find God this way. But I still sometimes wonder if this whole project will get way more out of hand. We have seen nothing yet.
https://t.co/AtatWwH6Co
  [Quoting @sunriseoath: Eliezer Yudkowsky is currently DMing the largest open world D&D instance in history.  https://t.co/RfUg7df7sZ]
↓
1796942894353305716 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Giving otherwise bitter and aimless nerds some big world-saving project to do was demonstrably a huge trigger for many people developing a pressing purpose in life, getting burned out on it, then finding themselves.

Maybe the true alignment project is showing autists the light.
↓
1796943189074399433 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Honestly, seems like a lot of similar projects could be done. Get people sniped by your little project that profits off their worst and most parasitic instincts while also trying to break them out of this loop. A charity where they profit off your sin nature til you change.
↓
1796943532755730572 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 💜 1
Of course this kind of thing ends up creating incentives for people to simply have rage farms where people are trapped in the game forever (politics, culture war, theology), but hey, I am just spitting out ideas on Twitter! I am but rambling. Please disagree and disregard.
↓
1796996619877147030 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
EA's ideas benefit from honest engagement, even as the specific set of central ideas will shift as the discussion continues. Of course, EA in general is trapped within the rationalist trap of believing despite knowing better that maps are *the* territory.
https://t.co/TiwWbzdXPG
  [Quoting @algekalipso: The reason EA is anti-fragile and why I expect it to continue existing, growing, and gaining in influence (or its memetics successor thereof) is that there are two main ways of criticizing it, and both help it:  1) attack the people not the ideas - EAs care about ideas, that will only prevent people who EA didn't care for to join their movement from not joining their movement (i.e. status conscious idea-blind people, who EA wants to filter *anyway*).  2) taking its ideas seriously and attacking them in as much detail as possible - dig into the orthogonality thesis, engage with aggregation assumptions in hedonistic consequentialism, try to refute the repugnant conclusion... By which point you will literally have turned into a (theory) EA, because having these conversations at a high level is literally what EA is all about.  It's a win-win for the memeplex.]
↓
1796996623597252764 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
At least two "meta-criticisms" of a movement:

(1) Attack the sources of the ideas and making it less desirable to shift; to the value judgments of the movement 

(2) Criticize the ontology of the movement in a way members of the movement understand.
↓
1796996626839380455 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
(1) reinforces the definition of the outgroup ("non-EA"), but in doing so solidifies what EA is.

(2) is hard in general, since the fact that someone is *in* a movement usually means they think its ontology is either self-evident or highly instrumental to use or posture.
↓
1796996629980938637 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath  [(SEED) type=quote_of_root]
In general you will find that the people concerned about particular issues or problems are the ones who cannot see past the problem either due to having no good object level solutions or no good meta level way of sidestepping. < survivorship bias plane >
https://t.co/21LhsP1x5Z
  [Quoting @eshear: If you are a smart, diligent, and effective person, you are pretty much guaranteed that any problem you’re currently facing is really nasty and hard to fix. Bc otherwise you’d already have fixed it.]
↓
1796996633319657937 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
My best model of autist vs. schizo is the former helps for object level and the latter helps for meta level. The followers and worshippers of Big Ideas are usually the former (Aaron), while the creators and leaders of those Big Ideas are usually the latter (Moses).
↓
1796997372171427903 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
The ideal rationalist is maxed out on both autism and schizophrenia so that they can not only operate fluently and methodically within systems, but also switch systems to never be trapped.

In practice, the rationalist movement snipes autists who get baited into semantic prisons.
↓
1796997940185092245 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Behind every rampant autist is a skilled schizophrene yanking his chain. You see this in organizations and systems of all kinds. Heck, you yourself are (if you are fairly mindful and meta-cognizant) such a system. "Instrumental rationality" is your schizo piloting your autist.
↓
1796998450111738338 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Less talked about is one's autist piloting one's schizo, and though it happens it is usually rare because autists uniquely disdain the schizo except when his words are already systematized. Unfortunately, the schizo idea or insight far predates the schizo white paper or thesis.
↓
1796998921819959345 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
You will see some autists tap into themselves and learn to think like a schizo to generate some incredible insights that they can then pilot with their usual systemic prowess. They might even see the alpha in being the schizo puppetmaster for other autists.

Most do not!
↓
1796999502311608720 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
There is also disdain that schizos feel for autists, but for the most part everyone can understand the power of systems. The problem is that using these systems is often tiring (Ikea tables are hard to put together for most people), so schizos are often hardware-gated.
↓
1796999995503116649 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 💜 175 🔁 12
Autists are software-gated from gaining schizo power because they often (as a result of our cultural reductive material scientific realism) heavily confuse phenomenology with metaphysics and so treat nonstandard ontologies the way they treat flat earthers: with palpable disdain.
↓
1797000429299028466 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Autism is depth. Schizo is breadth. 

(You could also say the inverse if it is more meaningful, but I will use my own ontology for now! Hope that's cool.)

Autists can dig endlessly in one place. Schizos can pick multiple places to dig based on vibes, man.
↓
1797001093244747831 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Only autist no schizo results in people getting nerdsniped for decades on narrow problems.

Only schizo no autist results in people being locked up in a room with a nice firm white coat that perfectly matches the walls.

The schizautist (zot, in my dictionary) is to be feared.
↓
1797001763880411260 [2024-06-01] @sunriseoath 
Of course there is another axis to this problem, one of reality versus fakeness. This is maybe the more pertinent ones when speaking about the zots battling it out. But *for the most part*, unintegrated people cannot intuit that reality is in part choice.
https://t.co/ilCRcIeGD5
  [Quoting @sunriseoath: @burny_tech Schizo at its most extreme has the same information as autism. (Ditto for sacramental-gnostic) https://t.co/byjBBEnOt7]
